entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker of Zendikar who stole a god's bident from Theros and tries to kill Ulamog, whom she thinks of as the sea god Ula, by summoning Lorthos.

entities.name: Shen
entities.description: A skeptical, devoted trickster of Cosi who follows Kiora and is killed by her after being controlled by Kozilek.

entities.name: Yesha
entities.description: A trickster of Cosi who accompanies Kiora and notes that if Ulamog leaves he can return.

entities.name: Tola
entities.description: A trickster of Cosi ordered to stay at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Inash
entities.description: A trickster of Cosi ordered to stay at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Runari
entities.description: A trickster of Cosi ordered to stay at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk ruin diver whom Shen calls trustworthy and who reported that Ulamog is coming.

entities.name: Kiora's sister
entities.description: Kiora's sister, who swims with a few dozen merfolk and has left her.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that Kiora sees as the sea-god Ula and finds trapped in a hedron ring.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whom the merfolk remember as the trickster god Cosi; he rises at Sea Gate, tears open the sea wall and kills Lorthos.

entities.name: Lorthos
entities.description: An enormous ancient octopus of Murasa whom Kiora summons with the bident to fight the titan.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A god of Theros from whom Kiora stole the bident and who hated her.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: The merfolk trickster god of old stories, understood as a memory of the titan Kozilek.

entities.name: Tricksters of Cosi
entities.description: Merfolk devotees of Cosi who are skeptical of gods and follow Kiora's story.

entities.name: Bident of Thassa
entities.description: A two-pronged weapon stolen from a god of Theros that lets Kiora channel power and summon Lorthos.

entities.name: Hedron prison
entities.description: The ring of hedrons that holds Ulamog until the hedrons fall.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The white-stone city whose sea wall holds back the Halimar Sea.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A region of Zendikar where Lorthos slumbers.

entities.name: Halimar Sea
entities.description: The sea held high above the ocean by Sea Gate.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Kiora stole the bident.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane under assault by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien creatures swarming around Ulamog and the titans.

events.summary: Kiora descends from Sea Gate on an octopus tentacle to rejoin her own army of tricksters and sea monsters after the other planeswalkers dismiss her.
events.quote: five of Cosi's own tricksters and a legion of sea monsters.

events.summary: Kiora tells the tricksters Ulamog is coming and that the other planeswalkers plan to trap him, while she plans to kill or drive him away.
events.quote: Our plan is to kill him if we can, and drive him off if we can't,

events.summary: Kiora leaves three tricksters at Sea Gate and swims out to open water with Shen, Yesha and half her armada.
events.quote: Kiora turned and swam away from Sea Gate, out into the open ocean.

events.summary: Kiora channels the bident through the sea and reaches to Murasa to wake Lorthos.
events.quote: The bident was calling. He would answer.

events.summary: Kiora summons Lorthos, who appears as a vast darkness, and she pleads with him to fight the interlopers.
Riding Lorthos, Kiora and the tricksters converge on Sea Gate.
events.quote: Slowly but inexorably, Lorthos and Ula converged on Sea Gate.

events.summary: Kiora sees Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring, then the hedrons fall and he is freed.
events.quote: Whatever the cause, the effect was clear: Ula was free of his prison.

events.summary: Kozilek rises from the bay and rips open the sea wall, letting the Halimar Sea pour through.
events.quote: Another and he stood before Sea Gate.

events.summary: Kiora realizes Cosi always won and that she has been tricked, as Kozilek turns toward her.
Kozilek takes control of Shen, who lunges at Kiora, and she kills him with the bident.
events.quote: She raised the bident, and its twin points buried themselves in Shen's chest.

events.summary: Kozilek cleaves Lorthos in two, and Kiora falls into the water and drops the bident.
Kiora realizes Kozilek never saw her and that she has killed her followers, then loses consciousness.
events.quote: She hit the water, and blackness claimed her.

relations.note: Kozilek splits Lorthos with his obsidian blades.
Kiora stabs Shen when he is controlled by Kozilek.
relations.quote: She raised the bident, and its twin points buried themselves in Shen's chest.

relations.note: Shen follows Kiora as one of her tricksters.
relations.quote: The tricksters didn't follow Kiora because she was a Planeswalker

relations.note: Kiora sets out to kill the titan she thinks of as Ula.
relations.quote: At last, she would punish Ula for what he had done to her people and her world

relations.note: Kiora stole Thassa's weapon, and Thassa hated her.
Cosi is the merfolk's garbled memory of Kozilek.
The tricksters are devoted to the faith of Cosi.
relations.quote: We who have kept the faith of Cosi know that there's nothing special about gods.
